rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides AI agents with semantic access to Microsoft Sentinel's security data lake. Enables natural language queries for security data exploration, entity risk analysis, incident triage, and threat hunting without requiring KQL expertise or schema knowledge. Supports building Security Copilot agents and integrates natively with Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and VS Code GitHub Copilot.
